3119.sigma:
title: AWS CloudTrail Logging Disabled or Trail Tampered
id: 6f0e2b1a-3c4d-4e5f-9a8b-1c2d3e4f5a6b
description: Detects CloudTrail management API calls that stop, delete or reconfigure a trail (StopLogging/DeleteTrail/UpdateTrail/PutEventSelectors), blinding cloud visibility.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cloud-logging-defense-evasion/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/008/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/26
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.008
logsource:
  product: aws
  service: cloudtrail
detection:
  selection:
    eventSource: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
    eventName:
      - StopLogging
      - DeleteTrail
      - UpdateTrail
      - PutEventSelectors
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Authorized infrastructure-as-code changes to trail configuration
  - Decommissioning of an account or region
level: high
3119.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Change where (All_Changes.command IN ("StopLogging","DeleteTrail","UpdateTrail","PutEventSelectors")) AND All_Changes.status="success" by All_Changes.user All_Changes.command All_Changes.object All_Changes.src All_Changes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
3119.datadog: source:cloudtrail @evt.name:(StopLogging OR DeleteTrail OR UpdateTrail OR PutEventSelectors) @evt.outcome:success
3119.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/cloudtrail
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.type, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.name, awsRegion
| filter eventSource = "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"
      and eventName in ["StopLogging", "DeleteTrail", "UpdateTrail", "PutEventSelectors"]
      and not isPresent(errorCode)
| sort @timestamp desc

3120.sigma:
title: AWS S3 Deletion of CloudTrail Log Storage Bucket
id: 8a1b2c3d-4e5f-4061-9b2c-7d8e9f0a1b2c
description: Detects DeleteBucket/DeleteObject(s) against an S3 bucket whose name indicates it stores CloudTrail/audit logs, destroying the log destination.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cloud-logging-defense-evasion/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/008/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/26
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1562.008
  - attack.t1485
logsource:
  product: aws
  service: cloudtrail
detection:
  selection:
    eventSource: s3.amazonaws.com
    eventName:
      - DeleteBucket
      - DeleteObject
      - DeleteObjects
  bucket_scope:
    requestParameters.bucketName|contains:
      - cloudtrail
      - log
      - audit
      - trail
  condition: selection and bucket_scope
falsepositives:
  - Lifecycle cleanup of expired log buckets by platform team
level: high
3120.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Change where (All_Changes.command IN ("DeleteBucket","DeleteObject","DeleteObjects")) AND All_Changes.status="success" AND (All_Changes.object IN ("*cloudtrail*","*log*","*audit*","*trail*")) by All_Changes.user All_Changes.command All_Changes.object All_Changes.src | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
3120.datadog: source:cloudtrail @evt.name:(DeleteBucket OR DeleteObject OR DeleteObjects) @requestParameters.bucketName:(*cloudtrail* OR *log* OR *audit* OR *trail*) @evt.outcome:success
3120.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/cloudtrail
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.bucketName, awsRegion
| filter eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com"
      and eventName in ["DeleteBucket", "DeleteObject", "DeleteObjects"]
      and (requestParameters.bucketName like /cloudtrail/i or requestParameters.bucketName like /log/i or requestParameters.bucketName like /audit/i or requestParameters.bucketName like /trail/i)
      and not isPresent(errorCode)
| sort @timestamp desc

description: Detects outbound network connection or DNS resolution to known C2 infrastructure for the May 2026 TeamPCP / UNC6780 Nx Console credential-stealer campaign (t.m-kosche.com, check.git-service.com, filev2.getsession.org, api.masscan.cloud, 83.142.209.194).
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/5-supply-chain-attacks-in-48-hours-why-securing-one-layer-is-not-enough
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.t1071.004
  - attack.command_and_control
logsource:
  category: dns
detection:
  selection_dns:
    QueryName:
      - 't.m-kosche.com'
      - 'check.git-service.com'
      - 'filev2.getsession.org'
      - 'api.masscan.cloud'
    QueryName|endswith:
      - '.t.m-kosche.com'
      - '.check.git-service.com'
      - '.filev2.getsession.org'
      - '.api.masscan.cloud'
  condition: selection_dns
falsepositives:
  - Sinkhole / passive-DNS researcher resolving the domains for tracking
level: critical

3231.datadog: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 (@DestinationHostname:(t.m-kosche.com OR check.git-service.com OR filev2.getsession.org OR api.masscan.cloud OR T.M-KOSCHE.COM OR Check.git-service.com) OR @DestinationIp:83.142.209.194)) OR (source:windows.defender @RemoteUrl:(*t.m-kosche.com* OR *check.git-service.com* OR *filev2.getsession.org* OR *api.masscan.cloud*))

title: macOS LaunchAgent Persistence via VS Code Helper or Python (Nx Console Implant)
id: 2e1c4f9a-6d3b-4a8c-91e2-f7c5b3d8e4a6
description: Detects creation of a macOS LaunchAgent / LaunchDaemon plist by VS Code Helper, node, or python — the persistence pattern used by the Nx Console Shai-Hulud backdoor.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/5-supply-chain-attacks-in-48-hours-why-securing-one-layer-is-not-enough
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.t1543.001
  - attack.t1547.011
  - attack.persistence
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: macos
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/Library/LaunchAgents/'
      - '/Library/LaunchDaemons/'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.plist'
  selection_writer:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/Code Helper'
      - '/Code Helper (Renderer)'
      - '/Code'
      - '/node'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
  condition: selection_path and selection_writer
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate VS Code extensions that install LaunchAgents (rare)
  - Developer manually installing a homebrew service
level: high
3232.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as path values(Filesystem.process_name) as writer from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path IN ("*/Library/LaunchAgents/*.plist","*/Library/LaunchDaemons/*.plist") AND Filesystem.process_name IN ("python","python3","node","Code Helper*","Code") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
3232.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:PATH (@file.path:(*/Library/LaunchAgents/*.plist OR */Library/LaunchDaemons/*.plist)) @process.name:(Code OR "Code Helper" OR node OR python OR python3)
3232.falcon: #event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\/Library\/Launch(Agents|Daemons)\/.+\.plist$/i ContextImageFileName=/(Code Helper|Code$|\/node$|\/python(3)?$)/i | groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName], function=count())

3234.def:
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where Application has "GitHub"
| where ActionType has_any ("git.clone","repo.download","git.fetch","repo.actions.workflow_run_download_artifact")
| extend RepoName = tostring(parse_json(tostring(RawEventData)).repo)
| extend Visibility = tostring(parse_json(tostring(RawEventData)).visibility)
| where Visibility == "private" or isempty(Visibility) // private OR unknown — err on alert
| summarize RepoCount = dcount(RepoName), RepoSample = make_set(RepoName, 50), FirstClone = min(Timestamp), LastClone = max(Timestamp), IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 10), UAs = make_set(UserAgent, 10) by AccountDisplayName, AccountObjectId, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where RepoCount >= 25 // empirical: P99 daily clones per dev is ~10–15; 25 in 1h is anomalous
| extend ClonesPerMinute = round(toreal(RepoCount) / ((LastClone - FirstClone) / 1m), 2)
| order by RepoCount desc

id: 5b7d1ab8-69f4-4f2a-8e10-9c3a02f5a2b6
description: Detects GraphWorm (Webworm APT, 2025) backdoor C2 traffic to Microsoft Graph OneDrive endpoints (notably /createUploadSession) from a process that is not Office, Edge, or the OneDrive client.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/eset-research/webworm-new-burrowing-techniques/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1567.002
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_graph:
    DestinationHostname|contains: 'graph.microsoft.com'
  selection_uri:
    DestinationUri|contains:
      - 'createUploadSession'
      - '/me/drive/items'
      - '/drives/'
      - '/me/drive/root:'
  filter_legit:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\OneDrive.exe'
      - '\OneDriveStandaloneUpdater.exe'
      - '\Teams.exe'
      - '\WINWORD.EXE'
      - '\EXCEL.EXE'
      - '\POWERPNT.EXE'
      - '\OUTLOOK.EXE'
      - '\ONENOTE.EXE'
  condition: selection_graph and selection_uri and not filter_legit
level: high
3249.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest="graph.microsoft.com" OR All_Traffic.url IN ("*graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/items/*createUploadSession*","*graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/drives/*createUploadSession*","*graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/root:*")) by All_Traffic.src,All_Traffic.dest,All_Traffic.user,All_Traffic.process_name,All_Traffic.url,_time | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | search NOT (process_name IN ("*\\msedge.exe","*\\chrome.exe","*\\firefox.exe","*\\OneDrive.exe","*\\OneDriveStandaloneUpdater.exe","*\\Teams.exe","*\\ms-teams.exe","*\\WINWORD.EXE","*\\EXCEL.EXE","*\\POWERPNT.EXE","*\\OUTLOOK.EXE","*\\ONENOTE.EXE","*\\Outlook.exe")) | stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen sum(count) as conn_count values(url) as urls by src,user,process_name,dest
3249.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:*graph.microsoft.com -@Image:(*\\msedge.exe OR *\\MsEdge.exe OR *\\chrome.exe OR *\\Chrome.exe OR *\\firefox.exe OR *\\OneDrive.exe OR *\\OneDriveStandaloneUpdater.exe OR *\\Teams.exe OR *\\ms-teams.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\ONENOTE.EXE OR *\\Outlook.exe OR *\\officeclicktorun.exe)
3249.falcon:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^graph\.microsoft\.com$/i
| ContextImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|cscript|wscript|rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|curl|wget)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, ContextProcessId], function=count())
| _count >= 2
